components.name: LogoCloud
components.summary: Logos (or names) as a grid, inline row, marquee, split, centered or card strip, in grayscale, muted or colour, with optional bordered tiles.
components.description: Use for strips of customers, partners or source projects, only with real, permitted names. Each entry has a `name` (alt text and text fallback), optional `src` image and optional `href`. Broken images fall back to the name. Layouts: `grid` (default), `inline` (centred wrapping row, best for 3-6 logos), `marquee` (continuous scroll using `Marquee`, for 10+ logos; logos are not links there), `with-title` (small caption on the left, logos in a grid on the right from `lg`), `split` (headline-size title on the left third, wrapping logos on the rest, from `lg`), `centered` (headline-size centred title above a centred wrapping row) and `card` (title and grid inside a bordered panel). `tone` picks grayscale-until-hover, always-muted or full colour (only the image is dimmed, text names keep full contrast); `size` sets logo height; `shape` draws each logo in a bordered tile (`rounded`, `square`, `pill`); `gap` sets the spacing between logos.

props.name: logos
props.description: `{ name: string, src?: string, href?: string }`. `name` is always required, even with `src` (it is the alt text). `href` is ignored by the `marquee` layout.

props.name: title
props.description: Caption: above the logos, or beside them in `with-title`. In `marquee` it also labels the scrolling group for assistive tech.

props.name: layout
props.description: Arrangement. `split` and `centered` use a headline-size title; `grid`, `inline`, `with-title` (smaller) and `card` use the caption size. `grid`, `with-title` and `card` use `columns`; `split` and `centered` wrap like `inline`. Unknown values fall back to `grid`. Reflected as `data-layout`.

props.name: tone
props.description: `grayscale` dims images until hover/focus; `color` shows them as is; `muted` keeps them dimmed and gives no hover or focus reveal. Only the image is dimmed, never the text. When unset, the `grayscale` prop decides. Invalid values are ignored.

props.name: shape
props.description: Logo tile. `plain` is the original borderless logo; `rounded`, `square` and `pill` draw a bordered tile on the card surface. Unknown values fall back to `plain`. Reflected as `data-shape`.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between logos (grid: 1rem/2rem/3rem columns, 1rem/1.5rem/2rem rows; row layouts: 1.5rem/2.5rem/4rem columns). In `marquee` `sm` uses the medium strip gap and `md` and `lg` the large one. Unknown values fall back to `md`. Reflected as `data-gap`.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Backwards-compatible switch for grayscale-until-hover. Only used when `tone` is not set.

props.name: size
props.description: Logo height: 2rem, 3rem, 4rem. Invalid values fall back to `md`.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns from `md` up in `grid` and `with-title`; invalid falls back to 5. Always 2 on mobile, 3 on `sm`. Ignored by `inline` and `marquee`.

props.name: duration
props.description: `marquee` only: seconds for one loop. Unset uses the Marquee default (30); invalid values also fall back to it.

props.name: direction
props.description: `marquee` only: scroll direction (Marquee default `left`).

props.name: class
props.description: Merged last; wins over internal classes.

a11y: grid, inline, with-title, split, centered and card render a native list; images use the name as alt (the text fallback is the name itself); linked logos are focusable with the shared focus ring and reveal colour on focus.
Contrast: only the image is dimmed in the grayscale tone. The text fallback is never faded (no opacity on text), so names keep the 4.5:1 ratio in light and dark mode.

marquee: the group is labelled by `title`; the duplicated copy is aria-hidden; logos there are not focusable links. It inherits Marquee's pause button (Tab, Enter/Space) and stops moving under prefers-reduced-motion.

`shape` tiles have a border, so they stay visible in forced-colors mode; the muted tone dims only the image, and text names keep the muted-foreground on card contrast pair. `card` is a plain bordered container, not a landmark. `split` and `centered` wrap instead of using columns.
Reflow: two columns at 320px, three from `sm`, then `columns` from `md`; names wrap instead of overflowing.
requires: Throws a ContractError when an entry of `logos` has no non-empty `name`, even if it has a `src`. The message names the first failing index.
llmNotes: Always give `name`, even when `src` is set (alt text).
Prefer SVG logos in the same visual height. Only list names you may show.
Use `layout="marquee"` for more than ~10 logos; use `inline` for a short hero strip; use `with-title` when the headline should sit beside the logos.
Use `layout="split"` or `"centered"` when the title is a real claim, `"card"` to set the strip apart, `shape` only when the logos need a tile, and `tone="muted"` for logos that are not links.
Use `tone="color"` on brand-coloured sections and `grayscale` on neutral ones; never pass both `tone` and `grayscale`.
Do not rely on `href` in the marquee layout.

components.name: Testimonial
components.summary: Customer quote with author, role, avatar and optional star rating in six layouts.
components.description: Use for customer or user quotes. Semantic `<figure>` + `<blockquote>` + `<figcaption>`. If the avatar image is missing or fails to load, initials from the author name are shown. Pick a `variant` for the context: `card` for walls of love, `quote` for one big pull quote, `inline` inside prose or sidebars, `with-rating` for review-style proof, `avatar-left` for a roomy row layout, `featured` to highlight the best quote in a grid. Several testimonials in a layout: use `TestimonialGrid` or `TestimonialSlider`.

props.name: quote
props.description: Required unless the default slot is used. The quote text (curly quotes are added automatically).

props.name: author
props.description: Person name. Required unless the `author` slot is used.

props.name: role
props.description: Job title / company.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Image URL; falls back to initials when missing or broken.

props.name: avatarAlt
props.description: Alt text of the avatar (empty = decorative, since the name is adjacent).

props.name: variant
props.description: Layout. `avatar-left` needs an avatar (image, author name or avatar slot) and otherwise renders like `card`. Unknown values fall back to `card`.

props.name: rating
props.description: Star rating from 0 to 5, rounded to the nearest half. Out-of-range values are clamped (7 -> 5, -1 -> 0); NaN, Infinity and non-numbers render no stars. Stars show in any variant; `with-rating` is the card style meant for it.

props.name: as
props.description: Root element.

props.name: size
props.description: Quote text and padding scale. `md` is the original look. Unknown values fall back to `md`. Exposed as `data-size`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Surface colour. `default` keeps the variant's own surface; `muted`, `primary` and `inverted` paint a filled surface and recolour the text, role line, stars and avatar to match. `quote` and `inline` gain a padded rounded box when a tone is set. Unknown values fall back to `default`. Exposed as `data-tone`.

props.name: shape
props.description: `square` removes the radius of the card and of the avatar. Unknown values fall back to `rounded`. Exposed as `data-shape`.

props.name: class
props.description: Merged last; wins over internal classes.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Replaces the quote text (no curly quotes added).

slots.name: avatar
slots.description: Replaces the avatar.

slots.name: author
slots.description: Replaces name and role.

a11y: Semantic `<figure>` + `<blockquote>` + `<figcaption>` relate the quote to its author; the initials avatar is aria-hidden and an image avatar is decorative unless you pass `avatarAlt`.

Stars are one role="img" element with aria-label such as "4.5 out of 5"; individual stars are aria-hidden. Filled stars use the foreground colour (not the warning colour) so they stay clearly visible against the empty ones in light and dark mode; the value is never colour-only.

No interactive parts, so there is no keyboard map. Text wraps (`text-pretty` / `text-balance`) and the card needs no horizontal space beyond its container, so it reflows at 320px; the quote rule of `inline` uses a logical `border-s-2` for RTL.
The `featured` variant is a solid primary border on the card surface (visible in forced-colors mode); no shadow or glow is used for emphasis in any variant.

Use real names, roles and ratings only; never fabricate testimonials. Examples use visibly sample text.
Leave `avatarAlt` empty unless the image conveys extra information.
Choose `quote` for a single hero quote, `inline` for compact use, `featured` for one highlighted card among cards.
Pass `rating` as a number 0-5; never as a string.

components.name: TestimonialGrid
components.summary: Wall of testimonials in a grid, masonry or side-by-side columns layout.
components.description: Lays out several `Testimonial`s. The `variant` is passed to every generated `Testimonial`. For a swipeable single row use `TestimonialSlider`.

components.name: TestimonialSlider
components.summary: Swipeable testimonial carousel built on CSS scroll-snap, no JavaScript carousel engine.
components.description: A horizontally scrolling, snap-aligned row of testimonials with optional previous/next buttons. Touch swiping, trackpad scrolling and keyboard (focus the track, then Left/Right arrows) all work. There is no autoplay by design. Use `perView` to show 2-3 slides on large screens. For a static wall use `TestimonialGrid`.

props.name: items
props.description: `{ quote?, author?, role?, avatar?, avatarAlt?, rating? }` per slide. Ignored when the default slot is used.

props.name: variant
props.description: Testimonial variant for generated slides. Unknown values fall back to `card`. The resolved value is exposed as `data-variant` on the root, also when the slides come from the slot.

props.name: size
props.description: Testimonial `size` for generated slides (quote and padding scale). Exposed as `data-size`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Testimonial `tone` for generated slides. Exposed as `data-tone`.

props.name: shape
props.description: Testimonial `shape` for generated slides. Exposed as `data-shape`.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the previous and next buttons sit under the track. Unknown values fall back to `end`. Exposed as `data-align`.

props.name: perView
props.description: Slides visible at once on large screens (always 1 on mobile, 2 from `md` for 3). Invalid values fall back to 1.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show previous/next buttons. At the ends (or when everything fits) they are aria-disabled, not disabled, so a focused button keeps focus.

props.name: label

a11y: The wrapper is role="region" with aria-roledescription="carousel" and an accessible name from `label` (give each carousel on a page a different `label`). The track is a focusable `role="group"` named by `slidesLabel`; generated slides are role="group" aria-roledescription="slide" labelled "n of N".

Keyboard map: Tab reaches the track, then Left/Right arrows scroll one page (visual direction, also in RTL); Tab continues to the Previous and Next buttons (Enter or Space). Arrow keys pressed inside a link or button in a slide are left alone. At the ends the buttons stay focusable (aria-disabled) and do nothing.

A visually hidden polite status region announces "Slide N of M" after scrolling settles on a different slide (scrollend, or a 150ms debounce); it is silent on load. The buttons are 36px (44px on coarse pointers) with the shared focus ring; chevrons mirror in RTL.

No autoplay, so there is nothing to pause. Smooth scrolling is replaced by instant scrolling under prefers-reduced-motion. One slide per view at 320px; the track scrolls inside itself, never the page.
requires: Throws a ContractError when `label` is an empty string (the carousel region needs a name), or, with `controls`, when `prevLabel` or `nextLabel` is empty.
Throws a ContractError when an entry of `items` has no non-empty `quote` or no non-empty `author` (the message names the first failing index).
llmNotes: Prefer TestimonialGrid when all quotes can be shown at once; use the slider when vertical space is tight.
Always set a meaningful `label` when the page has more than one carousel.
In custom slot content every slide needs `snap-start shrink-0` plus a basis class.

components.name: StatCounter
components.summary: Inline number with prefix, suffix, locale formatting and tabular figures. Static: it does not count up.
components.description: Use for a figure you can source, next to the claim it supports. It renders the final value immediately, formatted with `Intl` (`locale`, `decimals`) and set in tabular figures so columns of numbers line up. Non-finite values render `fallback` instead of "NaN". The count-up animation and its `animate` and `duration` props were removed (a count-up on statistics is a stock effect and moves text that people are trying to read); both props are still accepted and ignored. Used by `StatGrid`. `size`, `tone` and `align` are optional looks: unset, the figure is an inline span that inherits the surrounding size and colour.

props.name: value
props.description: Number to show. NaN/Infinity render `fallback`.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text before the number, e.g. "$".

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text after the number, e.g. "%".

props.name: decimals
props.description: Fraction digits, clamped to 0-6.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for grouping/decimal separators. Invalid locales fall back to plain digits.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Shown when `value` is not a finite number.

props.name: size
props.description: Figure size, semibold: `sm` 24px, `md` 36px, `lg` 60px. Unset inherits the surrounding type size (the original behaviour, and what `StatGrid` relies on). Unknown values are ignored. Reflected as `data-size`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Figure colour. `default` inherits the surrounding colour; the others use the `text-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, `text-success`, `text-info` and `text-destructive` tokens. Unknown values fall back to `default`. Reflected as `data-tone`.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment. Setting it makes the figure a block (`block text-start|center|end`); unset it stays inline. Logical values, so they mirror in right-to-left pages. Unknown values are ignored. Reflected as `data-align`.

props.name: duration
props.description: Deprecated no-op. The count-up animation was removed.

props.name: animate
props.description: Deprecated no-op. The number is always static.

props.name: class
props.description: Merged last; wins over internal classes.

requires: Throws a ContractError when `value` is not a finite number (NaN, Infinity, undefined), unless an explicit `fallback` text is set for the unavailable state.

examples.title: Static value
examples.code: <StatCounter :value="170" class="text-4xl font-semibold" />

examples.title: Decimals, prefix and fallback

examples.code: <StatCounter :value="1234.5" :decimals="2" locale="de-DE" class="text-3xl font-semibold" />

examples.description: Static figures. Unset `size` inherits the surrounding size, as in the examples above. Sample values.

examples.title: Tone gallery: default, primary, muted, success, info, danger
examples.description: The colour only styles the number. Always put a visible label next to it, so the meaning does not depend on colour.
examples.code:

examples.title: Align gallery: start, center, end
examples.description: Setting `align` makes the figure a block so the text can align inside its container.

a11y: A plain text node: screen readers read the formatted number once. There is no aria-hidden copy, no live region and no animation to pause or to reduce.
`tabular-nums` keeps digits the same width so numbers do not shift or misalign.

`size`, `tone` and `align` change looks only; the text node is the same. A tone is colour only and never the signal (a red number still needs its label); the tone tokens are tested against the page and card surfaces. `align` uses logical values and mirrors in right-to-left pages. The largest size is 60px semibold; it stays inside its container because the figure is text that wraps.
Give the number a visible label (StatGrid uses a description list); the number alone carries no meaning.
llmNotes: Pass numbers, never user-supplied strings.
Use `suffix` and `prefix` for units instead of concatenating outside.
Only show figures you can source. Do not invent metrics.
Do not pass `animate` or `duration`; they are ignored.
Leave `size` unset inside a heading or `StatGrid`; set it for a standalone figure. Use `tone` sparingly and always with a visible label.
replaces: hand-rolled StatCounter markup in app code

components.name: StatGrid
components.summary: Headline numbers with labels in five layouts, optional icons and trend indicators. Numbers are static.
components.description: Use to show 2-4 numbers you can source, next to the claim they support. A banner of big numbers with no source is a stock look, so only list figures you can reproduce. Numeric values render through `StatCounter` (static, tabular figures); string values (for example "24/7") are shown as-is. Uses a `<dl>` so labels and values are programmatically related. Variants: `plain` (default: bare numbers, no boxes), `cards` (bordered cards), `divided` (one panel with hairline dividers), `inline` (compact single row), `with-icons` (bare icon above each number). Any item can carry a `trend` and `change` for dashboards. The count-up animation was removed; the `animate` prop is accepted and ignored.

props.name: items
props.description: `{ value: number | string, label, prefix?, suffix?, decimals?, description?, icon?, trend?: "up" | "down" | "flat", change?: string }`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Layout. Unknown values fall back to `plain`.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns from `sm` up (4 uses 2 on `sm`, 4 on `lg`). Invalid falls back to 4. Ignored by `inline`.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment. Default depends on the variant: `left` for `cards` and `with-icons`, otherwise `center`. Invalid values use that default.

props.name: size
props.description: Figure size (`text-2xl`, `text-4xl`, `text-5xl`; `inline` uses `text-xl`, `text-2xl`, `text-3xl`). `cards` and `divided` scale their padding too. Unknown values fall back to `md`. Exposed as `data-size`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Figure colour: foreground, or the accent. Unknown values fall back to `default`. Exposed as `data-tone`.

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between stats. `md` keeps each variant's own spacing. `divided` draws its cell borders with a 1px gap and ignores it. Unknown values fall back to `md`. Exposed as `data-gap`.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corners of `cards` and `divided`. Unknown values fall back to `rounded`. Exposed as `data-shape`.

props.name: animate
props.description: Deprecated no-op. The count-up animation was removed; numbers are always static.

props.name: class
props.description: Merged last; wins over internal classes.

requires: Throws a ContractError when an item has an empty `label`, or a `value` that is not a finite number or a non-empty string (the first one is named by index).
a11y: Renders dl/dt/dd, so each label is programmatically tied to its value. Numbers are plain text with `tabular-nums`; there is no animation, live region or aria-hidden duplicate.
Trend arrows and icons are aria-hidden; the trend direction is announced through sr-only text ("Up", "Down", "No change") before the change text, and colour is never the only signal.
Columns collapse to one on phones (`grid-cols-1`), so it reflows at 320px. Alignment uses `text-start`, so RTL mirrors.
llmNotes: Only list numbers you can source or reproduce. Do not invent metrics.
Use numbers for formatted values, strings for pre-formatted ones.
Keep 2-4 items and place them next to the claim they support.
Do not pass `animate`; the count-up was removed.
Default `plain` has no boxes. Pick `cards` or `divided` on tinted backgrounds, `inline` for a one-line strip, `with-icons` when each stat has a clear symbol.
Pass `icon` as an IconDefinition object; it only renders in `with-icons`.
Use `trend` with `change` text; never encode direction by colour alone (the component already adds sr-only text).
replaces: hand-rolled StatGrid markup in app code

components.name: TeamGrid
components.summary: Responsive 2/3/4-column grid of team member cards with avatar or initials, role, bio and links.
components.description: Use on About/Team pages to introduce people. Pass `items` for the common case, or place your own `TeamMemberCard`s (or any element) in the default slot. One column on mobile, two from `sm`, then `columns` from `lg`. `variant` picks the card layout: `card` (bordered surface), `minimal` (no surface), `centered` (stacked and centred), `horizontal` (avatar beside the text). Do not use for a handful of testimonials (use Testimonial) or for people lists with data columns (use a table).

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns on large screens; invalid values fall back to 3.

props.name: variant
props.description: Card layout forwarded to every generated card; unknown values fall back to `card`.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between members: `sm` 16px, `md` 24px (the original), `lg` 40px. Unknown values fall back to `md`.

props.name: size
props.description: TeamMemberCard `size` forwarded to every generated card (spacing, avatar and type scale). A member in `items` can carry its own `size`, which wins. Unknown values fall back to `md`. Cards placed in the default slot keep their own props.

props.name: shape
props.description: Avatar shape forwarded to every generated card: `circle`, `rounded` (12px radius) or `square` (6px radius). A member's own `shape` wins. Unknown values fall back to `circle`.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment forwarded to the generated `card` and `minimal` cards; a member's own `align` wins. `centered` is always centred and `horizontal` always start-aligned. Unknown values fall back to `start`.

props.name: items
props.description: Members: `{ name, role?, bio?, avatar?, avatarAlt?, links?: { label, href, icon?, external? }[], size?, shape?, align? }`. Non-array values and null entries are ignored. `name` is required and every link needs a `label` and an `href`.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level of member names; invalid values fall back to 3.

props.name: class
props.description: Merged last; wins over internal classes.

parts.name: TeamMemberCard
parts.description: A single member card. Used by TeamGrid; use it directly inside the default slot. Do not put `role="listitem"` on it: `role` is the member job title prop.

props.name: name
props.description: Display name. Also the avatar label and the source of fallback initials.

props.name: role
props.description: Job title or role.

props.name: bio
props.description: Short biography (the default slot overrides it).

props.name: avatar
props.description: Image URL; a missing or broken image falls back to initials.

props.name: avatarAlt
props.description: Alt text of the avatar image.

props.name: links
props.description: Links; every entry needs a non-empty `href` and `label` (a contract violation otherwise). With `icon` the link is icon-only and `label` becomes its aria-label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Layout; unknown values fall back to `card`.

props.name: size
props.description: Spacing, avatar size (card 64, 80 or 112px; minimal and centered 80, 96 or 128px; horizontal 48, 64 or 80px), name and text scale, card padding. Unknown values fall back to `md`.

props.name: shape
props.description: Avatar shape, forwarded to Avatar. The `name` and `avatarAlt` contract is the same in every shape. Unknown values fall back to `circle`.

props.name: align
props.description: `center` centres the avatar, text and links of the `card` and `minimal` layouts. Ignored by `centered` (already centred) and `horizontal`. Unknown values fall back to `start`.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level of the name.

props.name: class
props.description: Merged last.

examples.title: Realistic: section with heading and custom cards
examples.code:
<section class="space-y-10">
  <SectionHeading title="Replace this heading with a claim about the team" description="One sentence of supporting context." />
  <TeamGrid :columns="3">
    <TeamMemberCard name="Sample person A" role="Role title" bio="One or two sentences about this person." variant="centered" :links="links" />
    <TeamMemberCard name="Sample person B" role="Role title" variant="centered" />
  </TeamGrid>
</section>
examples.script: const links = [{ label: 'Email sample person A', href: 'mailto:name@example.com', icon: faEnvelope }]

a11y: With `items` the root is a native `<ul>` and each member an `<li>` (role="listitem" is never put on the card: `role` is the job-title prop). With the default slot, or when empty, the root is a plain `<div>`; wrap your cards in `<li>` inside your own `<ul>` for list semantics.
Names render as headings (`level`, default 3); keep levels consistent with the surrounding section.

Icon-only links use `label` as aria-label; the avatar is labelled with `avatarAlt` or the name (initials fallback is exposed as an image with the name). Every link is at least 24px square and 44px on coarse pointers, with the shared focus ring.

`size`, `shape`, `align` and `gap` change spacing and alignment only. The avatar keeps its label (`avatarAlt` or the name) in every shape, names stay headings, and link targets keep their 24px (44px coarse) minimum at every size.
Links with `external` open in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer". One column at 320px, two from `sm`; long names and bios wrap.
requires: Throws a ContractError when a member has no non-empty `name`, or a link has no non-empty `label` (the accessible name of an icon-only link) or `href`. Applies to `items` (the message names the first failing index) and to `TeamMemberCard`.
llmNotes: Use `items` unless cards need custom content; pass icons as FontAwesome IconDefinition objects.

Use real names only with permission; never invent people. Pick `variant="card"` by default, `centered` for leadership with big photos, `minimal` on already-carded pages, `horizontal` with `columns=2` and long bios.
Keep one `size` and one `shape` per grid. `align="center"` only moves `card` and `minimal`.
Pick `columns` 3 for 3/6/9 people, 4 for 4/8, 2 for 2/4.
Every icon-only link needs a `label`; it becomes the accessible name.
Pair with SectionHeading above it.
